correctness.rationale: For fixed m>=2,n>=3, uniform spherical centers project to independent uniform B^{m-1} transverse coordinates and iid azimuths. Coverage near w0=pi/n forces O(sqrt eps) transverse offsets and near-regular gap spacings. With labeled-first cyclic origin, the uniform gap simplex has volume S_+^{n-1}/(n-1)! and hence conditional probability (S_+/(2pi))^{n-1}, giving exact independent Dirichlet slack. Rescaling U=sqrt(eps)y and a compact Taylor bound yields exponent n(m+1)/2-1 and gamma coefficient, with L1/TV convergence to Beta(n(m-1)/2,n) radial law. Independently recomputed C_{2,4}=64/(5pi).
residual_risks: Fixed m,n and a prescribed target great circle; whole-sphere coverage and uniformity in dimension/cap count are excluded; Beta law only asymptotic.
